findings.reason: the cost the lead weighed and the mechanism the node implements disagree, so a reader provisioning nodes from the decision installs external renderers the chosen approach then says it does not need.
findings.text: §10's Reuse paragraph states `resvg_py` is a declared dependency so "the render needs no external tool on a login or compute node", while the `svg-figure-delivery` decision it is built from (line 458) records the accepted cost as "a renderer wherever dispatch runs (rsvg-convert on login nodes, the convert fallback on compute nodes)"

findings.reason: a node implementing the exemption where §12 names it cannot make the exclusion not apply, so the plan must name `_ordered_review_lanes` (or `_review_lane_plan`) as the change site.
findings.text: §12 says "the change is in review lane selection … `_review_lane_candidates` and `_no_lane_reason`" and that "a lane that declares the modality is not removed by `review_excluded_backends`", but `_review_lane_candidates` only adds a lane's own reading; the exclusion is applied in `_ordered_review_lanes` (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1259), which drops every name in `excluded` before `_review_lane_candidates` sees a candidate

findings.reason: a node regenerating those pairs, which §8's own `draw_pairs.py` reproduces, would be refused at promotion by §11's check, so the pairs directory needs a stated carve-out.
findings.text: §11 states the figure rule "keeps one SVG per figure and bans a PNG copy beside it" and refuses a run that commits `a.png` beside a committed `a.svg` under a figures directory, but §8's deliverable (line 223) keeps each pair "as the SVG it was drawn in and as a PNG rendered from it, under `docs/figures/figure-review-pairs/`", and the repository holds ten such SVG/PNG twins there; §11 names no exception

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — each cited symbol resolves: `_rasterise_svg` (reckon/serve.py:2019, with `resvg-py`/`pillow` declared in pyproject.toml), `audit_manifest` (reckon/crew/reports.py:2330) plus `crew check-manifest` and `crew complete`, `_review_lane_candidates` (:1375) and `_no_lane_reason` (:1396) in reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py, `missing_input_modalities` (reckon/flight.py:1968) and `select_profile_backend` (reckon/flight.py:1980, called only from tests/test_flight.py), and docs/plans/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion.html §6.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §10 (rasterising call removed from the dispatch), §11 (twin check removed) and §12 (exemption removed) each declare a negative control that reddens the stated assertion, so each gate can show its guard fires.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §10 writes its PNG and gate log under the run directory, §11's test builds its own repository in a temporary directory, and §12 runs in place on the fleet allocation; nothing lands in a scratchpad or a node-local path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new test files (`test_dispatch_renders_svg_figures.py`, `test_a_png_twin_of_an_svg_is_refused.py`, `test_a_figure_review_takes_an_image_lane.py`) and symbols carry no plan label, stage name, ticket number or changelog prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: findings — §10's reuse contradicts the decision it is built from on the renderer dependency, §12 names a change site that cannot carry the exclusion it describes, and §11's twin rule would refuse the artifact shape this plan's own §8 delivers.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §10 renders an SVG to PNG on the dispatch, §11 refuses a PNG twin at promotion, §12 lets a figure review take an image lane; §12's retirement of `select_profile_backend` is the same selection-path change rather than a second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the plan declares `plan-informs` `scoring-should-stop-a-promotion` (whose §6 is the figure-review role §12 hands off to), and no `depends-on` is claimed or needed; the two locked decisions scope `data-sections` to §4 (deferred) and §8, which correctly leaves §10–§12 dispatchable.
